title: “I Don’t Think RAI Applies to My Model” – Engaging Non-champions with Sticky Stories for Responsible AI Work

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated by measuring practitioners' ability and engagement in identifying potential harms related to the unequal allocation of resources and opportunities in their own ML systems, comparing their performance when using standard assessments versus when prompted with LLM-generated 'sticky stories'.

Evaluated by tracking the quantity, diversity, and depth of harms practitioners surface regarding stereotyping, demeaning, or erasing outputs in their own models during a guided think-aloud harm identification task.
